subject: english
title: Final Test — Units 1 to 9
subtitle: Whole-level final · v1 · 17 slides · ExamView L4U1–9 · how the test runs → what the app marks (47) and what Neritan marks (33) → the full answer key Q1–Q47 → the Q48 writing rubric → the Q49 speaking script with its picture → reading the result by skill

content: Administer the ExamView Units 1–9 final: play TR 9.5 for Q1 and TR 9.6 for Q40–47, and run the Q49 speaking prompts from the wagon picture.
Mark the open responses — Q8–10, Q37–39, Q46–47, the Q48 writing and the Q49 speaking — against the publisher's key and rubric, and any rewrite (Q25–27) whose wording the key did not predict.
Read the result by skill (vocabulary 18 · grammar 17 · reading 19 · listening 6 · writing 10 · speaking 10) and pick what to re-teach before Level 5.
language: Check the comparatives and superlatives from across the level: older, more difficult, better, the funniest.
Check who for people and which for things, and used to for a past habit that has changed.
Check would like, should and will for offers, advice and predictions.
Check the double comparative the longer… the more…
